short_description: Rockstar's own Ultimate Edition page lists five places that are "only open for business with the Ultimate Edition": Rideout Customs and One-Eyed Willie's (mod shops), Sara's Unisex Salon, Electric Fang Tattoo and the Stock 305 clothing store. Standard is $79.99, Ultimate $99.99 (Tom's Guide, Shacknews). No story spoilers. Footage: official Rockstar screenshots.

short.headline: 5 SHOPS LOCKED
short.text: GTA 6 has five shops you can't use unless you bought the hundred dollar edition.
short.text_es: GTA 6 tiene cinco tiendas que no puedes usar si no compraste la edición de cien dólares.

short.headline: 2 MOD SHOPS
short.text: Rideout Customs and One-Eyed Willie's are mod shops. Rockstar's own words: only open for business with the Ultimate Edition.
short.text_es: Rideout Customs y One-Eyed Willie's son talleres. Palabras de Rockstar: solo abren con la Ultimate Edition.

short.headline: SALON, INK, CLOTHES
short.text: Same for Sara's Unisex Salon, the Electric Fang tattoo shop, and the Stock 305 clothing store.
short.text_es: Igual con Sara's Unisex Salon, el estudio de tatuajes Electric Fang y la tienda de ropa Stock 305.
